description: One EXTERNAL source identified by the lineage pass: a piece of prior art, precedent, or canonical text, with the claim read from it and its attribution. A source with no claim cites nothing in particular; url and citation carry the locator the claim was verified against. locator_status says whether the locator was fetched in this run; locator_kind says what kind of surface it reaches; a secondary surface is apparatus, never the locator of a work.

locator_status.description: fetched = the page at url was retrieved by a tool in this run and the quote was read from it; unverified = it was not, and the hit says what was tried.

locator_kind.description: What the url reaches: a named edition's own text, a paper (DOI or publisher article page), a library/archive scan — or a secondary surface (encyclopedia, catalogue, slide deck, bookseller, biography), or no locator at all.

quote.description: The exact passage the claim is read from, verbatim from the fetched page. Empty when locator_status is unverified.

tried.description: When unverified: what was searched or fetched and what came back.
